description: Sector run: ethics, responsibility and society, scoped to the norms, values and responsibilities of software engineering. Written as the COMPLEMENT of the generic run: publications covering open-source and community governance of AI-written code, which the generic run does not collect. Both URLs were fetched and parsed as feeds on 2026-11-09, each with items from the previous week. The pool is a thin floor; the prompt's searches are the real method. hackerNewsTerms is deliberately empty: measured on 2026-11-09, 'AI contribution policy', 'AI-generated code policy', 'Assisted-by', 'AI generated code liability', 'AI slop pull requests', 'AI disclosure commits' and 'Cyber Resilience Act' each returned ZERO stories in 60 days at the collector's points>30 threshold, and the other terms tried returned only unrelated launches. Tried and left out: Phoronix (mostly hardware and release news), The Register's DevOps feed (newest item August 2026), the Open Source Initiative (policy rather than engineering practice) and Tech Policy Press (platform policy). The labour and China feeds of the first version (Sixth Tone, Rest of World, Labor Notes, AlgorithmWatch, Connected by Data) were dropped with the labour beat. windowDays matches the prompt's 45-day window.
